0x0007FC.en: 「With my skills as they are...@ this is as far as I go...!」

0x00086D.en: 「Guh! Is this as far as I go...!!」

0x0008F5.en: 「Damn it!@ You won't get me next time!」

0x0009E6.en: 「Time to fall back...! I'm pulling out.」

0x000A1E.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000A56.en: 「Oh dear...@ How uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000B1F.en: 「Tch! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000B5A.en: 「No way I'm blowing it here...!@ This isn't funny...」

0x000BAE.en: 「I blew it...!@ Nothing to do but pull out...」

0x000CFF.en: 「This is the end... the rest is up to you.」

0x000D6D.en: 「Ngh! So they got the better of me...」

0x000DAB.en: 「No good, we've taken too much... I'm retreating!」

0x000DF8.en: 「I'm beaten. I leave the rest to you.」

0x000E36.en: 「Kyah! I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000E7D.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F28.en: 「Ngh... so I'm the one who becomes a shooting star... I'm bailing out!」

0x000FA7.en: 「Th-this is as far as I can go...!」

0x000FDF.en: 「Ow ow ow... I give up, my math was off.」

0x001020.en: 「Oh boy, they went and got me!」

0x001064.en: 「U... ngh! So this is the end...!」

0x0010D1.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001118.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x00114D.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x001239.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I've still got a long way to go...!」

0x001287.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001342.en: 「Sorry, I'm leaving the rest to you!」

0x001371.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013AF.en: 「Well, well, this is the end for me.」

0x0013DE.en: 「I can do no more. I'll take my leave.」

0x001469.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x0015CF.en: 「I'm ejecting...@ Ngh...! Can't even make it look good...」

0x00168D.en: 「Guhhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0017FC.en: 「So I've still got much to learn...!」

0x001998.en: 「Th... that's... obvious, isn't it......@ Before you were the captain of the Cry Wolves......」

0x001B2F.en: 「Tch...... started having that same dream again......」

0x001BBF.en: 「Hugo, are you there? I need to talk to you.」

0x001CC1.en: 「Hey, why don't you go to the infirmary?」

0x001CEC.en: 「I'm fine. So, what did you want to talk about?」

0x001D1A.en: 「When you were talking with Ratsel,@ you mentioned you'd been at Bunker 1@ in the Zentr Project.」

0x001E28.en: 「I've only ever been to the Hawaii bunker......@ They told me Bunker 1's location is classified,@ so nobody ever said where it was.」

0x001EEB.en: 「I don't know where Bunker 1 is either.」

0x001F1F.en: 「Huh? But you said you'd been there......」

0x001F65.en: 「That was the old Bunker 1.@ It's been abandoned since the accident.」

0x002021.en: 「Back then, the Zentr Project couldn't tame it@ and let it go berserk.」

0x00209B.en: 「Afterward the Cry Wolves were ordered to hunt it down......@ but you know how that turned out.」

0x002112.en: (The only survivors were Major Albero Est@ and Hugo... after that, Major Kai's team@ finished Jetzt off......)

0x0021AE.en: 「......I've asked before, but@ what was the Zentr Project@ making Jetzt for......?」

0x00222F.en: 「They meant to weaponize it, it seems,@ but I don't know the details.」

0x00228B.en: 「Don't tell me the Project@ is still researching Jetzt......?」

0x002303.en: 「H-hey......@ we are doing the right thing, aren't we......?」

0x002372.en: 「Protecting Earth from enemies like@ the <Einst> and <Inspectors>...... the Zentr Project@ is for that too......」

0x002412.en: 「Mitarl said as much, but that's just a pretext.」

0x0024DE.en: 「What's in that hangar over there is......@ Captain Axel's SoulGain.」

0x002546.en: 「Yes. We recovered it after he vanished.」

0x002586.en: 「I read the report on that incident.@ Kouta and Axel Almer fought an unidentified enemy,@ and were pulled into a dimensional gate.」

0x00262E.en: 「Yes. I think Kyosuke, Ryusei, the Steel Dragon Squadron,@ Shine, and Sanger's group vanishing are somehow tied to that too......」

0x002703.en: 「Each may have its own separate cause.@ There's more than one way@ to open the door to another world.」

0x0027B8.en: 「Setting aside Masaki, who came from La Gias,@ there's the Shadow Mirror, the Einst, the Shura,@ and this whole string of disappearances......」

0x002854.en: 「As time passes, these boundary anomalies grow more frequent......@ and lately the intervals between them@ seem to be getting shorter.」

0x0028EA.en: 「Isn't this the sign of some greater upheaval to come?@ That's the feeling I get......」

0x00294F.en: 「Wow, those clouds and islands...... this really feels like a southern sea.」

0x002995.en: 「You were the same on the transport plane too.@ You really love looking at the scenery.」

0x0029FA.en: 「Yeah, it's all so new to me.@ I lived in Antarctica ever since I was a child.」

0x002AA6.en: 「The first time in a really long while.」

0x002ACE.en: 「Shut away in a world of ice the whole time.@ I couldn't stand it if it were me......」

0x002B3C.en: 「But I never got bored.@ My father and brother were with me......」

0x002BA7.en: 「There are a lot of odd people at Re-Tech, but@ they were kind to me. And I helped out with@ my father and the others' research too.」

0x002C6E.en: 「Yes, testing the Sympathia@ mounted in my brother's Aile Chevalier......」

0x002D1C.en: 「The Aile Chevalier's@ man-machine interface......@ it links to the pilot's brain waves, apparently.」

0x002E06.en: 「The concept's close, but it doesn't need@ special powers like psychodrive......」

0x002E65.en: 「But...... why were you@ testing the Sympathia, Lim......?」

0x002EBE.en: 「Because I was the very first one to make it move......」

0x002F17.en: (Like Joshua said......@ does that mean Lim was made into an experiment too......?)

0x002F88.en: 「Huh, that's amazing.@ So can you pilot the Aile Chevalier too,@ Lim?」

0x003003.en: 「Only my brother can move it, but@ I was trained too......」

0x0030B5.en: 「Sorry for what? Why are you apologizing?」

0x00314F.en: 「Lord Ratsel,@ a high-speed aerial object is approaching us.」

0x00323C.en: 「If they were watching us from above,@ they'd teleport their forces in much closer.」

0x0032B6.en: 「Issue a warning, and if it still@ keeps approaching, attack.@ We'll board our machines and stand by.」

0x003356.en: 「Lord Ratsel, the target group has ignored the warning@ and entered Range 3.」

0x0033EC.en: 「Those machines of theirs......@ they're the same ones that attacked us in Izu.」

0x00343C.en: 「To show up even in a place like this......@ they've got quite a wide range.」

0x003495.en: 「Heh, we're in luck. Barely back on the ground@ and we run straight into the Kurogane.」

0x003516.en: 「Captain, word from the recovery ship.@ They're requesting a change to the rendezvous point.」

0x00358A.en: 「Understood. We'll draw their attention while the detachment@ links up with the recovery ship. Don't forget to prep our pickup.」

0x003648.en: 「The lot in front of us are a bonus.@ Play it right, and it'll add some serious shine to the data.」

0x0036B6.en: 「You don't need to worry about the machines anymore.@ The Federation's analysis is surely progressing too.@ ......Go earn your keep.」

0x00376E.en: (Heh...... the greedy ones make good shields)

0x0037B1.en: (......Ibis doesn't seem to be among them)

0x0037EE.en: 「That fighter, it looks like the Carrion...!」

0x003851.en: 「Series 77, the Vegalion......@ To think it was actually built...!」

0x0038B0.en: 「It's Ratsel Feinschmecker.@ And the one piloting that machine is Sleigh Presty......@ is that you?」

0x00394C.en: 「I see, you were acquainted. What will you do?@ Leave this to me - will you fall back?」

0x0039C3.en: 「Whoever the enemy is, I gather combat data...@　that's what my sponsor demands.@　My personal affairs have no bearing on the mission.」

0x003AAE.en: （I'll drag Ibis down out of the Alterion,@　and complete my brother's Project TD myself...）

0x003B37.en: （To do that, I'll use anyone -- Isurugi Heavy Industries@　or whoever else it takes...!）

0x003B9F.en: 「...Hey, Seolla.@　That pilot in the crimson machine --@　do you know them?」

0x003C08.en: 「An acquaintance of an acquaintance, to be exact.@　But Ratsel, he's...」

0x003C95.en: 「Ratsel, one enemy alone would be one thing,@　but with this many hostiles out there...」

0x003D2B.en: 「This one moves differently from the rest.」

0x003D5F.en: 「The commander unit of a special tactics squad.@　Looks like I'll get some fine combat data.」

0x003DBE.en: 「A machine I've never seen... let's see what it can do.」

0x003DFE.en: 「Don't think you'll get that data so easily!」

0x003E3B.en: 「Heh heh heh, luck is with me.@　To cross paths with so many new prototypes...」

0x003E97.en: 「Maybe the data's mutual... but@　I've no intention of handing over my life!」

0x003EFF.en: （Ratsel Feinschmecker...@　even you get no mercy from me!）

0x003F6D.en: 「Still fixated on settling things with Ibis.@　Even with Filio gone... no, because of it.」

0x004030.en: 「You've got skill.@　A worthy opponent for this Vegalion...!」

0x00408F.en: 「Impressive as ever...!@　Sleigh, we're pulling back. Handle recovery.」

0x0040D9.en: 「I'm still fighting.@　To perfect the Vegalion completely,@　I need combat data from them too.」

0x004163.en: 「Don't tell me you mean to make contact with them?」

0x0041AC.en: 「Those words... I'll take that as an insult.」

0x0041DD.en: 「Hmph, fine. I'll rendezvous with the recovery team.」

0x00421A.en: 「Ngh, this is as far as we go! Fall back!」

0x004292.en: 「...I've nothing to say to you.@　But I'll tell you one thing.」

0x0042EE.en: 「Drag Ibis down out of the Alterion...@　That is my one and absolute reason to fight.」

0x004377.en: 「So it was you after all, Sleigh...@　But Ibis is...」

0x0043CD.en: 「She'll be back before long. Along with the Steel Dragons.」

0x0044AD.en: 「A-and he said Ibis and the Steel Dragons@　are coming back!」

0x00452E.en: 「Does she know where the Steel Dragons are...!?」

0x00466C.en: 「No results!? So they're a different alien race!?」
